title: 第1992章 主神之位第1991章 第五真传
lines: 第1992章主神之位
陈默此刻来到六百阶梯之上。
那压力大增，却让陈默的肉身突破了桎梏。
武神是一个神位，更多的是代表神祗之中的战斗力。
陈默神力足够，神力之内有武道意境，脑海内更有武道意志。
在陈默身后，是许多为了提升实力攀爬阶梯的修士。
他们此刻远远被陈默甩开。
但是他们望着陈默的背影，均是觉得伟岸如山。
“这家伙真是太强了。”
有人望着陈默，几乎是无法相信自己的眼睛，“仅仅是半天时间他就来到了六百层，照这样下去，定能达到九百层。”
“到时候，他将拥有主神之境。”
此次各大天才为了竞争神威，几乎是倾巢而出，但他们并没像陈默一样来到六百阶梯，大多数人还是止步于一百阶梯。
他们想继续走下去，需要足够的时候感悟周围的力量。
但是陈默不同，他有五行之力，以及天道法则和雷电法则。
相对而言，陈默的种种力量，可以让他在九天雷峰闲庭信步。
一步步往上走，陈默来到七百阶梯这里。
在不远处的位置，陈默看到熟悉的背影，使得陈默下意识认真看去。
“是他？”
陈默逐渐认出对方的身影，正是陈松子。
不过这陈松子和自己相识的陈松子，有太大的差别。
如果说以前的陈松子就是凡人。
那么此刻的陈松子，则是透着浑厚无比的气息。
他似是比陈默还要强大，整个人屹立不倒。
就在陈默看向陈松子之际，陈松子同样抬头看向陈默。
“师父，你来了？”
陈松子开口说道：“几百年前，尊主告诉我，只要在这里等候便能见到你，如今看来，尊主真是没有骗我。”
陈松子此言一出，陈默神色闪动。
他没有想到。
陈松子会出现在这里。
尤其是对方的状态，完全知道自己会来这里。
并且陈松子开口就提洞天大帝。
显然，这件事是洞天大帝的安排。
但是陈默不明白，洞天大帝为何会有未卜先知的能力。
见陈默没有说话，陈松子苦涩一笑。
“师父，接下来再往上走，便是主神之位，你我二人只能一人证道。”
“毕竟这九天雷峰的神力，不足以两人成为主神。”
此言一出，陈默顿时惊讶了。
“陈松子，你怎会知这九天雷峰的神力，不足以让两人成就主神？”
听了这话，陈松子解释道：“师父，并非是徒儿知道这件事，而是人人皆知，九天雷峰神力浩瀚，能够成就主神者无一不是天赋杰出之辈，我陈松子在这里修炼了几百年，却只能拥有武神实力，若能打败师父，获得师父的气运之力，倒是能成就主神。”
话音落下，陈默终于明白九天雷峰的底细。
只能一人成就主神。
不论如何看，这都让陈默进退两难。
一边是徒弟，一边是主神之位。
content_en:
Chapter 1992 The position of the Lord God
Chen Mo now reached the six hundred steps.
The pressure increased greatly, but Chen Mo's physical body broke through the shackles.
The God of War is a god who represents more of the fighting power among the gods.
Chen Mo has enough divine power. Within his divine power is the artistic conception of martial arts, and in his mind is the will of martial arts.
Behind Chen Mo were many monks climbing the ladder to improve their strength.
They were far away from Chen Mo at this moment.
But when they looked at Chen Mo's back, they all felt that he was as majestic as a mountain.
"This guy is really strong."
Someone looked at Chen Mo, almost unable to believe his eyes, "He reached the 600th floor in just half a day. If he continues like this, he will definitely reach the 900th floor."
"At that time, he will have the realm of the Lord God."
This time, all the great geniuses came out in almost all numbers to compete for divine power, but they did not reach the 600th step like Chen Mo. Most of them still stopped at the 100th step.
They want to continue walking and need enough time to appreciate the power around them.
But Chen Mo is different. He has the power of the five elements, as well as the laws of heaven and the laws of thunder and lightning.
Relatively speaking, Chen Mo's various powers allow him to stroll around the Nine Heavens Thunder Peak.
Walking up step by step, Chen Mo came to the seven hundred steps.
Not far away, Chen Mo saw a familiar figure from behind, which made Chen Mo look at it carefully subconsciously.
"Is it him?"
Chen Mo gradually recognized the other person's figure as Chen Songzi.
However, there is a big difference between this Chen Songzi and the Chen Songzi he knew.
If we say that Chen Songzi was a mortal before.
So at this moment, Chen Songzi exudes an extremely rich aura.
He seemed to be more powerful than Chen Mo, and he stood firm.
Just when Chen Mo looked at Chen Songzi, Chen Songzi also looked up at Chen Mo.
"Master, are you here?"
Chen Songzi said: "Hundreds of years ago, the Lord told me that I could see you as long as I waited here. Now it seems that the Lord really did not lie to me."
As soon as Chen Songzi said this, Chen Mo's expression flashed.
He didn't expect that.
Chen Songzi will appear here.
Especially the other party's state, fully knowing that he would come here.
And Chen Songzi mentioned Dongtian Emperor whenever he opened his mouth.
Obviously, this matter was arranged by Emperor Dongtian.
But Chen Mo didn't understand why Dongtian Emperor had the ability to predict the unknown.
Seeing that Chen Mo didn't speak, Chen Songzi smiled bitterly.
"Master, if you go up further, you will reach the position of the Lord God. Only one of you and I can prove the truth."
"After all, the divine power of the Nine Heavens Thunder Peak is not enough for two people to become the main gods."
As soon as these words came out, Chen Mo was immediately surprised.
"Chen Songzi, how did you know that the power of the Nine Heavens Thunder Peak is not enough for two people to become master gods?"
After hearing this, Chen Songzi explained: "Master, it's not that my disciple knows this, but everyone knows that the Nine Heavens Thunder Peak has vast divine power, and those who can become the main god are all talented people. I, Chen Songzi, have practiced here for hundreds of years, but I can only have the strength of a martial god. If I can defeat the master and obtain the power of master's luck, I can become the main god."
After the words fell, Chen Mo finally understood the details of Jiutian Lei Feng.
Only one person can become the Lord God.
No matter how you look at it, this puts Chen Mo in a dilemma.
One side is the disciple, and the other side is the master god.
title_en: Chapter 1992 The Position of the Lord God Chapter 1991 The Fifth True Succession
